description: Alerts for 30 days on every confirmed transaction paying to or spending from the address: private feed (web, JSON, RSS) and phone push. Returns the feed links. Price: 1000 sats or US$1 (USDC) per call.

feed.description: Optional: an existing Address Watch feed id to add to or extend

l402.description: Optional. After paying the Lightning invoice: '<token>:<preimage>'.

pay_with.description: Optional. 'lightning' returns a BOLT11 invoice and a token instead of the x402 payment request.

name: watch_bitcoin_address
